Hi Rishi,

Welcome — thanks for choosing SecureAssess for your vendor security questionnaire intake. We created a portal workspace for Redwood Inference and uploaded the default questionnaire bundle (SOC 2 bridge, CAIQ v5 mapping, and SIG Lite).

- Upload your SOC 2 2025 attestation (if available) and any control-specific evidence.
- Fill the attached Evidence Inventory Template with owner, S3 path (or Drive link), and last review date.
